crossRefs.note: “Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar…
Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.

people.name: Damascus
people.line: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.

people.name: Hamath
people.line: A major city and kingdom in Syria, often mentioned in the Bible.

people.name: Hazar-enan
people.line: Town on the northern border of Israel

translations.web: The border from the sea, shall be Hazar Enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.
translations.bsb: So the border will run from the Sea to Hazar-enan, along the northern border of Damascus, with the territory of Hamath to the north. This will be the northern boundary.
translations.kjv: And the border from the sea shall be Hazarenan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And this is the north side.
translations.asv: And the border from the sea, shall be Hazar-enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.
